definitions.gamma_common: gamma on requests whose output every variant reproduces exactly
definitions.ranking_wait: loop steps a correct node waited although proposed early enough
definitions.proposal_wait: loop steps lost because the correct node was proposed late or never
definitions.contested_selection: selection boundaries with more candidates than N
definitions.positive_contested_selection: boundaries with more positive-score candidates than N
definitions.selection_changed: same pool re-ranked at another c changes the selected set

limits: instrumented diagnostic: loop-step counts only, not throughput
stratified subset; suffix history is shorter than in the full-dataset runs
BF16 tree shapes may change outputs; oracle falls back after leaving the reference
single run; no request-order or timing repeats
